title: note.template Response Application Programming Interface (API) Schema
description: Response from the note.template request indicating whether the template was successfully applied to the specified Notefile.

total.description: The total number of bytes that will be used for templated Notes using this template.

template.description: The total number of bytes that will be used for the Note template portion.

body.description: The total number of bytes that will be used for the Note body portion.
